system.description: SPRING TO SUMMER Although slow to rise, the anger of the forest is irrevocable in its ascent and terrible to behold. At the beginning of the encounter, place a token on space 0 time a forest offers one or more critical wounds from a single hit or is the target of a critical hit. Each time the forest offers one or more critical wounds from a single hit or is the target of a critical hit, advance the token 1 to the right. When the token reaches space 3, all Melee Attacks or Ranged Attacks by Forest Spirits gain {Dm} for the duration of the encounter. When the token reaches space 6, all Melee Attacks or Ranged Attacks made by spirits instead gain {Dm} and inflict +2 damage for the remainder of the encounter.
